content: ensure_daemon() now waits up to 12 seconds for the socket before it spawns a second daemon; the old 3 second wait started duplicate daemons on slow disks.
The hub answered HTTP 421 Misdirected Request when a client reused one TLS connection for a different host name; the fix was to turn off connection coalescing in the proxy.
qjl_bits sets how many bits the QJL quantizer keeps per dimension. It defaults to 1, and 2 is allowed for stores under 50k facts.
rrf_k stays at 15 because the candidate pools hold 50 to 200 items; k=60 flattened the fused ranking too much.
Every SQLite connection sets PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and busy_timeout=5000, which ended the 'database is locked' errors under concurrent writers.
The migration runner lives in storage/migrations/__init__.py and applies files named M0NN_*.py in numeric order.
Setting SLM_RECALL_NO_FLOOR=1 switches off the evidence floor; it exists for debugging only and must never ship in a default config.
parse_window() accepts phrases like 'last week' or an ISO date range and returns a pair of UTC datetimes, or None when it cannot read the input.
The regex ^\[[A-Za-z]+\]:\s* strips speaker prefixes such as '[Alice]: ' before the cross-encoder scores a fact.
reranker.warmup_sync(timeout=300) blocks until the cross-encoder worker has loaded its model or the timeout passes, and returns True only when it is ready.
The atomic_facts_fts table is an FTS5 index kept in sync by triggers, so a fact is keyword-searchable the moment its row is inserted.
CANONICAL_RECALL_LIMIT is 10; the MCP recall tool caps any larger limit to 50 before it reaches the engine.

Python 3.14 is supported from 4.1.20, but lancedb wheels lag behind, so the vector backend stays on sqlite-vec.
The MCP conformance harness needs Node 22 while the CI workflow still pins Node 20, so that one job fails on every run.
pydantic 2.13.4 hard-pins pydantic-core 2.46.4, so there is no upgrade path around the garbage-collector crash.
CSLS, cross-domain similarity local scaling, subtracts each item's average similarity to its neighbours so that hub items stop matching every query.
RRF means reciprocal rank fusion: every channel adds 1/(k + rank) for each item it returns.
FSRS stability grows with each successful recall, so notes that are used often decay more slowly.
The SLA for the hosted gateway is 99.5 percent monthly uptime with a 4 hour response for P1 incidents.
For a GDPR erasure request we delete the memory rows at once and queue their vectors for purge within 30 days.
MRR, mean reciprocal rank, averages 1/rank of the first correct answer over all questions.
